name: pitchpredict
description: Real Football Prediction Web App with Basic and Serious Game Modes

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.mobile:build: npm run build:client && npx cap sync
